meta.description: Hand-curated vanilla Fire Emblem Fates recruitment per route (UGF 2.5.2 changes supports only, so recruitment is vanilla). Consumed by tools/extract/build_recruitment.py.
notes: chapter/recruit order and optional status: Serenes Forest route recruitment pages (Pegasus Knight tables).
join level, join class and promotedAtJoin: Serenes Forest route base-stats pages, cross-checked against Fire Emblem Wiki character pages where they differ (see docs/DATA.md).
child paralogues: all unlock after Chapter 7 + the fixed parent's marriage (Fire Emblem Wiki); in Birthright, Paralogue 6 additionally needs Chapter 15 and Kaze's A support with Corrin.
Anna: DLC xenologue 'Anna on the Run'; the Dragon's Gate opens after Chapter 6 (Serenes Forest DLC page).
My Castle recruits (Izana, Fuga, Yukimura, Flora): Serenes marks the chapter as '~', meaning from that chapter onwards once the building upgrade and a battle are done.
keys: chapter number; paralogues/children and the DLC xenologue use the chapter they unlock after plus 0.5; same-key units keep source order (in-game join order).
